annotations.title: Wallet profile: balances, activity, contract check and sanctions

description: One call to profile an EVM wallet: native and USDC balances on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon, transaction counts on Base and Ethereum, whether it is a contract or a plain wallet, its recent USDC transfers on Base, and an OFAC sanctions screen. Cheaper than the tools bought one by one. Use before paying, onboarding or trusting a counterparty wallet; for a single risk verdict use check_counterparty. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
